children: Traws Pharma entered into a stock purchase facility with Roth Principal Investments that gives the company the option to sell up to $50 million of newly issued shares over a 36-month period after specified conditions are met. A related registration rights agreement requires Traws Pharma to file a registration statement for resale of shares issuable under the facility, and purchases cannot commence until the SEC declares it effective. The company says any proceeds will support product-candidate development, working capital and general corporate purposes.
